+#!/bin/sh
+set -eu
+
+case "$0" in
+  */*) launcher_dir=${0%/*} ;;
+  *) launcher_dir=. ;;
+esac
+launcher_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$launcher_dir" && pwd)
+deploy_root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$launcher_dir/.." && pwd)
+test_path="$deploy_root/tests/test_self_maintenance_loop_runner_policy.py"
+
+resolve_python() {
+  candidate=$1
+  case "$candidate" in
+    */*)
+      if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then
+        printf '%s\n' "$candidate"
+      fi
+      ;;
+    *) command -v "$candidate" 2>/dev/null || true ;;
+  esac
+}
+
+supports_focused_tests() {
+  "$1" -c '
+import sys
+if sys.version_info < (3, 11):
+    raise SystemExit(1)
+import apscheduler
+import pytest
+from starlette.exceptions import StarletteDeprecationWarning
+' >/dev/null 2>&1
+}
+
+run_if_supported() {
+  resolved=$(resolve_python "$1")
+  if [ -n "$resolved" ] && supports_focused_tests "$resolved"; then
+    exec "$resolved" -m pytest "$test_path" -q
+  fi
+}
+
+if [ -n "${MODSTORE_SELF_MAINTENANCE_TEST_PYTHON:-}" ]; then
+  run_if_supported "$MODSTORE_SELF_MAINTENANCE_TEST_PYTHON"
+else
+  run_if_supported "$deploy_root/.venv/bin/python"
+  for candidate in python3.13 python3.12 python3.11 python3 python; do
+    run_if_supported "$candidate"
+  done
+fi
+
+printf '%s\n' \
+  'self-maintenance focused test requires Python >=3.11 with apscheduler, pytest, and compatible Starlette' \
+  >&2
+exit 2

executable_template.applicability_check: Use when a self-maintenance code or report-only QA worker cannot execute the focused policy test because the prompt contains an interpreter path that exists only on the scheduler host, or a bare Python resolves below the repository's >=3.11 requirement.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Replace the scheduler-local default command with a repository-relative shell launcher, make the launcher select only Python >=3.11 environments with pytest, APScheduler, and compatible Starlette, and require report-only QA to run it from a complete target-ref archive.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert the launcher, command generator, QA prompt, and focused regressions together; until an equivalent portable executor exists, keep structured QA fail-closed rather than accepting syntax-only or wrong-interpreter evidence.
